prompt: W: This is Rainbow Carpets. ____?
answer: How can I help you today
full_sentence: W: This is Rainbow Carpets. How can I help you today?
translation_ko: 여기는 Rainbow Carpets입니다. 오늘 어떻게 도와드릴까요?

prompt: M: Hello. I'm ____ in my living room. So I'd like to arrange for someone from your company to visit my home later this week to discuss this.
answer: planning to replace the carpet
full_sentence: M: Hello. I'm planning to replace the carpet in my living room. So I'd like to arrange for someone from your company to visit my home later this week to discuss this.
translation_ko: 안녕하세요. 저는 제 거실에 카펫을 교체하려고 계획하고 있어요. 그래서 이번 주 후반에 당신의 회사에서 누군가 저의 집에 와서 이에 대해 논의할 일정을 잡고 싶어요.

prompt: W: Of course. What ____?
answer: are you looking to replace it with
full_sentence: W: Of course. What are you looking to replace it with?
translation_ko: 물론이죠. 어떤 것으로 교체하길 원하시나요?

prompt: M: I want something ____.
answer: that is sturdy and won't wear out quickly
full_sentence: M: I want something that is sturdy and won't wear out quickly.
translation_ko: 튼튼하고 빨리 닳지 않는 것으로 원합니다.

prompt: W: We only sell carpets that last for a long time. ____ on Saturday at around 2 P.M.?
answer: Why don't I visit your home
full_sentence: W: We only sell carpets that last for a long time. Why don't I visit your home on Saturday at around 2 P.M.?
translation_ko: 저희는 오래 지속되는 카펫만 판매합니다. 토요일 오후 2시경에 제가 댁으로 방문하는 것은 어떨까요?

prompt: M: Could you come on Thursday afternoon instead? I'll be ____.
answer: traveling to Portland this weekend to attend my cousin's wedding
full_sentence: M: Could you come on Thursday afternoon instead? I'll be traveling to Portland this weekend to attend my cousin's wedding.
translation_ko: 대신 목요일 오후에 오실 수 있을까요? 저는 사촌의 결혼식에 참석하기 위해 이번 주말에 포틀랜드에 갈 거예요.

answer: Let me check my schedule
full_sentence: W: Hmm . . . Let me check my schedule.
translation_ko: 음... 제 일정을 확인해 보겠습니다.

prompt: W: Welcome to the High Road Diner. ____?
answer: Do you have a reservation
full_sentence: W: Welcome to the High Road Diner. Do you have a reservation?
translation_ko: High Road 식당에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 예약이 되어 있으신가요?

prompt: M: Yes. I ____ under the name of Greg Jensen. And ____.
answer: booked a table for six people / requested the use of your private room
full_sentence: M: Yes. I booked a table for six people under the name of Greg Jensen. And I requested the use of your private room.
translation_ko: 네, Greg Jensen이라는 이름으로 6명을 위한 테이블을 예약했어요. 그리고 개인실 사용을 요청했습니다.

prompt: W: Oh, I'm very sorry Mr. Jensen. There was a mix-up, so ____. But we have ____ for your group.
answer: another party is already using that room / a table by a window that will be large enough
full_sentence: W: Oh, I'm very sorry Mr. Jensen. There was a mix-up, so another party is already using that room. But we have a table by a window that will be large enough for your group.
translation_ko: 아, 정말 죄송합니다, Mr. Jensen. 혼선이 있어서 다른 손님들이 이미 그 방을 사용 중입니다. 하지만 창가에 있는 테이블이 있는데, 이것이 손님 일행에게 충분히 클 것입니다.

prompt: M: Really? But I'm having lunch ____. That's why I requested the private room today.
answer: with some important international clients
full_sentence: M: Really? But I'm having lunch with some important international clients. That's why I requested the private room today.
translation_ko: 정말요? 하지만 저는 오늘 중요한 국제 고객들과 점심식사를 할 거예요. 그래서 오늘 개인실을 요청했던 겁니다.

prompt: W: Again, I apologize. ____, I'll have your waiter ____.
answer: To make up for our mistake / bring you a complimentary appetizer
full_sentence: W: Again, I apologize. To make up for our mistake, I'll have your waiter bring you a complimentary appetizer.
translation_ko: 다시 한번 사과드립니다. 저희의 실수에 대해 보상해 드리기 위해, 당신의 웨이터가 무료 전채 요리를 가져다 드리도록 하겠습니다.

prompt: M: Ms. Choi, ____ for your students?
answer: have you finished planning the field trip
full_sentence: M: Ms. Choi, have you finished planning the field trip for your students?
translation_ko: Ms. Choi, 학생들을 위한 현장 학습을 계획하는 것을 마치셨나요?

prompt: W: Yes. I'm ____ next Friday.
answer: taking them to the Museum of Natural History
full_sentence: W: Yes. I'm taking them to the Museum of Natural History next Friday.
translation_ko: 네. 저는 다음 주 금요일에 그들을 자연사 박물관으로 데려갈 예정이에요.

prompt: M: They should enjoy that. I heard the museum ____.
answer: just opened another exhibition hall
full_sentence: M: They should enjoy that. I heard the museum just opened another exhibition hall.
translation_ko: 그들이 좋아할 것 같네요. 저는 그 박물관이 또 다른 전시실을 막 열었다고 들었어요.

prompt: W: Right. I ____ of the museum, Mr. Willis. He ____ to the general public.
answer: booked a tour with the director / will take us to areas that are off-limits
full_sentence: W: Right. I booked a tour with the director of the museum, Mr. Willis. He will take us to areas that are off-limits to the general public.
translation_ko: 맞아요. 저는 박물관 관장인 Mr. Willis와 투어를 예약했어요. 그가 일반인들에게는 출입금지인 구역으로 우리를 안내해 줄 거예요.

prompt: M: I'd like ____.
answer: to do something similar with my students
full_sentence: M: I'd like to do something similar with my students.
translation_ko: 저도 제 학생들과 비슷한 것을 해보고 싶네요.

prompt: W: ____ Mr. Willis to book a tour?
answer: Why don't you call
full_sentence: W: Why don't you call Mr. Willis to book a tour?
translation_ko: Mr. Willis에게 전화해서 투어를 예약하는 게 어때요?

prompt: W: Do you ____, Abed? I'm ____ this afternoon, but the projector in the second-floor conference room ____. Do you have any idea what's wrong with it?
answer: have a minute / trying to prepare for my sales presentation / keeps shutting down
full_sentence: W: Do you have a minute, Abed? I'm trying to prepare for my sales presentation this afternoon, but the projector in the second-floor conference room keeps shutting down. Do you have any idea what's wrong with it?
translation_ko: 잠시 시간 있나요, Abed? 오늘 오후에 있을 판매 발표를 준비하고 있는데, 2층 회의실의 프로젝터가 계속 꺼져요. 무엇이 문제인지 알고 계신가요?

prompt: M: You should ask David ____. He usually ____.
answer: in tech support to look at it / handles these types of issues
full_sentence: M: You should ask David in tech support to look at it. He usually handles these types of issues.
translation_ko: 기술 지원 부서의 David에게 그것을 확인해 달라고 요청하세요. 그는 보통 이런 유형의 문제들을 처리해요.

prompt: W: But my client ____. I'm worried that ____. I'm going to ____ on the first floor. Hopefully, it's free.
answer: will be arriving in about 30 minutes / there won't be enough time to fix it / check the schedule for the conference room
full_sentence: W: But my client will be arriving in about 30 minutes. I'm worried that there won't be enough time to fix it. I'm going to check the schedule for the conference room on the first floor. Hopefully, it's free.
translation_ko: 하지만 제 고객이 약 30분 후에 도착할 예정이에요. 그것을 수리할 시간이 충분하지 않을까봐 걱정돼요. 저는 1층 회의실 일정을 확인해 볼게요. 비어있길 바라요.

prompt: M: Good idea. And if you need help ____, let me know.
answer: moving your materials for the presentation
full_sentence: M: Good idea. And if you need help moving your materials for the presentation, let me know.
translation_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 그리고 발표를 위한 자료들을 옮기는 데 도움이 필요하시면 제게 알려주세요.

prompt: M: Ms. Yoon. I heard ____ that was held last week. Congratulations!
answer: you won the dessert competition
full_sentence: M: Ms. Yoon. I heard you won the dessert competition that was held last week. Congratulations!
translation_ko: Ms. Yoon, 지난주에 열렸던 디저트 대회에서 당신이 우승했다고 들었어요. 축하합니다!

prompt: W: Thanks. I was surprised ____. It ____. Um, what did you ____ today?
answer: by the large number of participants / made the contest really challenging / want to talk to me about
full_sentence: W: Thanks. I was surprised by the large number of participants. It made the contest really challenging. Um, what did you want to talk to me about today?
translation_ko: 감사합니다. 저는 많은 참가자 수에 놀랐어요. 그것이 대회를 정말 도전적으로 만들었어요. 음, 오늘 무엇에 관해 제게 이야기를 하고 싶으신가요?

prompt: M: I'm ____ on a project. My company ____. We ____ diet-conscious consumers. I think ____ for this project.
answer: interested in working with you / is currently developing a new line of snacks / want to create healthy desserts targeting / you're the ideal person
full_sentence: M: I'm interested in working with you on a project. My company is currently developing a new line of snacks. We want to create healthy desserts targeting diet-conscious consumers. I think you're the ideal person for this project.
translation_ko: 저는 프로젝트에서 당신과 함께 일하는 데 관심이 있습니다. 저희 회사는 현재 새로운 스낵 라인을 개발하고 있어요. 저희는 식단에 신경 쓰는 소비자들을 대상으로 하는 건강한 디저트를 만들고 싶습니다. 당신이 이 프로젝트에 가장 알맞은 사람이라고 생각해요.

prompt: W: That sounds interesting. Could you send me an e-mail ____? I'll go over it tomorrow and then get back to you.
answer: with details about your plan
full_sentence: W: That sounds interesting. Could you send me an e-mail with details about your plan? I'll go over it tomorrow and then get back to you.
translation_ko: 흥미롭게 들리네요. 당신의 계획에 대한 세부 사항이 담긴 이메일을 보내주시겠어요? 제가 내일 그것을 검토하고 연락드리겠습니다.

prompt: M: Welcome to Tanya Coffee Shop. ____?
answer: May I take your order
full_sentence: M: Welcome to Tanya Coffee Shop. May I take your order?
translation_ko: Tanya 커피숍에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 주문하시겠습니까?

prompt: W: I'd like some drinks and food ____. Do you ____?
answer: for my company's morning meeting / offer delivery service
full_sentence: W: I'd like some drinks and food for my company's morning meeting. Do you offer delivery service?
translation_ko: 회사 아침 회의를 위한 음료와 음식을 주문하고 싶습니다. 배달 서비스를 제공하나요?

prompt: M: Yes. We provide ____.
answer: free delivery for orders over 30 dollars
full_sentence: M: Yes. We provide free delivery for orders over 30 dollars.
translation_ko: 네. 30달러 이상 주문하시면 무료로 배달해 드립니다.

prompt: W: OK. I'd like coffee and an assortment of pastries for about 15 people. And please ____ as some of our team members have nut allergies.
answer: ensure that the pastries are nut-free
full_sentence: W: OK. I'd like coffee and an assortment of pastries for about 15 people. And please ensure that the pastries are nut-free as some of our team members have nut allergies.
translation_ko: 알겠어요. 약 15명을 위한 커피와 다양한 종류의 페이스트리를 주문하고 싶어요. 그리고 일부 팀원들이 견과류 알레르기가 있으니 페이스트리에 견과류가 없도록 해주세요.

prompt: M: No problem. Do you think you will be ____?
answer: placing similar orders in the future
full_sentence: M: No problem. Do you think you will be placing similar orders in the future?
translation_ko: 문제 없습니다. 앞으로도 이와 비슷한 주문을 하실 계획인가요?

prompt: W: Yes. We ____ like this each month.
answer: are planning to have a meeting
full_sentence: W: Yes. We are planning to have a meeting like this each month.
translation_ko: 네. 매달 이런 회의를 열 계획입니다.

prompt: M: If you ____, you can get a 20 percent discount on all your repeat orders. I ____.
answer: order through our mobile app / suggest downloading it
full_sentence: M: If you order through our mobile app, you can get a 20 percent discount on all your repeat orders. I suggest downloading it.
translation_ko: 모바일 앱으로 주문하시면 모든 재주문에 대해 20퍼센트 할인을 받으실 수 있어요. 앱을 다운로드하시는 것을 추천합니다.

prompt: M: Good morning, Ms. Sanders. This is Carter from Gold Realtors. I'm calling ____ three-bedroom apartment in the San Lucas neighborhood.
answer: to let you know about a newly listed
full_sentence: M: Good morning, Ms. Sanders. This is Carter from Gold Realtors. I'm calling to let you know about a newly listed three-bedroom apartment in the San Lucas neighborhood.
translation_ko: 안녕하세요, Ms. Sanders, Gold 공인중개사 사무소의 Carter입니다. 샌 루카스 지역에 새로 매물로 나온 침실 세 개짜리 아파트에 대해 알려드리려고 전화드립니다.

prompt: W: ____. Um, are there ____? As I mentioned before, I want to live in a building ____.
answer: Thank you for calling / many buses in that area / with easy access to public transportation
full_sentence: W: Thank you for calling. Um, are there many buses in that area? As I mentioned before, I want to live in a building with easy access to public transportation.
translation_ko: 전화해 주셔서 감사해요. 음, 그 지역에 버스가 많이 다니나요? 제가 전에 언급했듯이, 대중교통에 쉽게 접근할 수 있는 건물에서 살고 싶어요.

prompt: M: It's close to a metro station. So ____.
answer: you will be able to get around easily
full_sentence: M: It's close to a metro station. So you will be able to get around easily.
translation_ko: 지하철역 가까이에 있어요. 그래서 쉽게 돌아다니실 수 있을 거예요.

prompt: W: Great. Could you ____ on Saturday morning?
answer: show me that apartment
full_sentence: W: Great. Could you show me that apartment on Saturday morning?
translation_ko: 좋네요. 토요일 오전에 그 아파트를 보여주실 수 있나요?

prompt: M: I have ____ before lunch. How about 2 P.M.?
answer: appointments with several other clients
full_sentence: M: I have appointments with several other clients before lunch. How about 2 P.M.?
translation_ko: 제가 점심 전에 다른 여러 고객들과 약속이 있어요. 오후 2시는 어떨까요?

prompt: W: OK. Please text me the address, and I'll ____.
answer: make sure to arrive on time
full_sentence: W: OK. Please text me the address, and I'll make sure to arrive on time.
translation_ko: 알겠습니다. 주소를 문자로 보내주세요, 그러면 제가 정시에 도착할 수 있도록 하겠습니다.

prompt: M: Anita, I want to ____. It's been low lately. We're ____.
answer: discuss productivity at our shoe factory / barely meeting our monthly quotas
full_sentence: M: Anita, I want to discuss productivity at our shoe factory. It's been low lately. We're barely meeting our monthly quotas.
translation_ko: Anita, 저는 우리 신발 공장의 생산성에 대해 논의하고 싶어요. 최근에 생산성이 낮아졌어요. 우리는 간신히 월별 할당량을 맞추고 있어요.

prompt: W: What do you think is ____?
answer: causing this decline
full_sentence: W: What do you think is causing this decline?
translation_ko: 이러한 하락을 야기하는 원인이 무엇이라고 생각하세요?

prompt: M: I think the issue is ____ last year.
answer: the staff members we recruited
full_sentence: M: I think the issue is the staff members we recruited last year.
translation_ko: 저는 문제가 작년에 우리가 채용한 직원들이라고 생각합니다.

prompt: M: They aren't ____. It is likely because they ____.
answer: meeting our performance expectations / did not receive proper training
full_sentence: M: They aren't meeting our performance expectations. It is likely because they did not receive proper training.
translation_ko: 그들은 우리의 업무 성과 기대치를 충족시키지 못하고 있어요. 아마도 적절한 교육을 받지 못했기 때문일 거예요.

prompt: W: But they ____.
answer: went through our normal orientation process
full_sentence: W: But they went through our normal orientation process.
translation_ko: 하지만 그들은 정상적인 오리엔테이션 과정을 거쳤어요.

prompt: M: Actually, they only got two days of training ____.
answer: instead of the usual four
full_sentence: M: Actually, they only got two days of training instead of the usual four.
translation_ko: 사실, 그들은 보통의 4일 대신 2일간의 교육만 받았어요.

prompt: W: Hmm . . . Maybe we should ____.
answer: organize some additional workshops
full_sentence: W: Hmm . . . Maybe we should organize some additional workshops.
translation_ko: 흠... 아마도 우리가 추가 워크숍을 준비해야 할 것 같네요.

prompt: M: Mindy, is ____ going well?
answer: the customer survey for our store
full_sentence: M: Mindy, is the customer survey for our store going well?
translation_ko: Mindy, 우리 매장에 대한 고객 설문조사가 잘 진행되고 있나요?

prompt: W: Yes. About 300 ____. I'll ____ next Wednesday.
answer: customers have responded / send you the survey results
full_sentence: W: Yes. About 300 customers have responded. I'll send you the survey results next Wednesday.
translation_ko: 네. 대략 300명의 고객들이 응답했어요. 다음 주 수요일에 설문조사 결과를 보내드릴게요.

prompt: M: Good. And ____ this morning. Sales have ____ last quarter.
answer: I reviewed the quarterly sales report / significantly increased compared to
full_sentence: M: Good. And I reviewed the quarterly sales report this morning. Sales have significantly increased compared to last quarter.
translation_ko: 좋아요. 그리고 오늘 아침에 분기별 판매 보고서를 검토했어요. 지난 분기와 비교해서 판매가 크게 증가했어요.

prompt: W: I think that's because of the ____.
answer: ads we posted on various social media platforms
full_sentence: W: I think that's because of the ads we posted on various social media platforms.
translation_ko: 그것은 우리가 다양한 소셜 미디어 플랫폼에 게시한 광고 덕분이라고 생각해요.

prompt: M: Right. But I'm concerned about ____. It hasn't sold well for several months now. Hmm . . . We should ____.
answer: the brand with the second-lowest sales / probably offer a discount
full_sentence: M: Right. But I'm concerned about the brand with the second-lowest sales. It hasn't sold well for several months now. Hmm . . . We should probably offer a discount.
translation_ko: 맞아요. 하지만 저는 두 번째로 낮은 판매량을 가진 브랜드가 걱정돼요. 몇 개월 동안 잘 팔리지 않았어요. 흠... 아마도 우리는 할인을 제공해야 할 것 같아요.

prompt: W: I agree. ____ by 15 percent?
answer: Why don't we mark it down
full_sentence: W: I agree. Why don't we mark it down by 15 percent?
translation_ko: 동의해요. 15퍼센트 정도 할인하는 건 어떨까요?

prompt: M: Welcome to Swift Auto Rentals. ____ today?
answer: Are you interested in a rental
full_sentence: M: Welcome to Swift Auto Rentals. Are you interested in a rental today?
translation_ko: Swift 자동차 렌트 업체에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 오늘 렌트에 관심이 있으신가요?

prompt: W: ____ here in Seattle ____ at an international book fair. But I forgot ____.
answer: My coworkers and I just arrived / to represent our company / to book a vehicle in advance
full_sentence: W: My coworkers and I just arrived here in Seattle to represent our company at an international book fair. But I forgot to book a vehicle in advance.
translation_ko: 저와 동료들이 우리 회사를 대표해서 국제 도서 박람회에 참석하기 위해 방금 시애틀에 도착했어요. 하지만 제가 미리 차량을 예약하는 것을 잊었어요.

prompt: M: No worries. We have ____. What ____ do you have?
answer: a variety of cars available / specific requirements
full_sentence: M: No worries. We have a variety of cars available. What specific requirements do you have?
translation_ko: 걱정하지 마세요. 다양한 차량이 이용 가능합니다. 어떤 특별한 요구사항이 있으신가요?

prompt: W: We need a car that can comfortably seat five people and ____, as we're traveling with ____.
answer: has enough space for our luggage / quite a bit of equipment
full_sentence: W: We need a car that can comfortably seat five people and has enough space for our luggage, as we're traveling with quite a bit of equipment.
